app.name: Hinge
app.description: A dating app designed to be deleted, focused on fostering serious relationships through detailed profiles and conversation prompts.

verdict.one_liner: Hinge collects extremely sensitive personal data including your sexual orientation, health info, racial background, and face geometry, and shares some data with advertisers and vendors.
verdict.summary: Hinge collects account details, profile information, user content, and sensitive categories including sexual orientation, sexual life, health, racial or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, and political affiliations. The app also gathers purchase records, device and usage data, geolocation, face geometry for verification, and government ID if provided. Social media imports and details about others submitted via reports are also processed. Data is visible to members through profiles and disclosed to outside vendors for hosting, payments, analytics, and security. Advertising partners receive certain information for campaigns, and some of it is transformed into non-identifiable forms. Related companies also receive data to improve safety, recommendations, and cross-platform features. Users may request access, correction, deletion, or restriction. Retention periods vary: a safety window lasts three months after account closure (up to two years after a ban). Financial records kept for ten years. Face data erased within thirty days. Customer care exchanges and approximate download locations retained for five years. Biometric confirmation images may be retained for thirty-six months.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Hinge collects extremely sensitive personal data including sexual orientation, health information, and biometrics. It shares some data with advertisers and vendors, and retains some information for years even after you delete your account.

red.title: Collects highly sensitive data
red.plain_english: Hinge collects information about your sexual orientation, health, race, religion, and politics if you choose to provide it. This is extremely personal and could be harmful if leaked.

red.title: Collects your face geometry
red.plain_english: Hinge may scan your face to verify your identity. Biometric confirmation images may be retained for up to thirty-six months.

red.title: Shares data with advertisers
red.plain_english: Hinge shares certain information with advertising partners so they can target ads to you. Some of your data is transformed into a form that cannot be used to identify you personally.

red.title: Keeps data for years
red.plain_english: Even after you delete your account, Hinge keeps your financial records for ten years, your customer care exchanges for five years, and biometric confirmation images for up to thirty-six months.

red.title: May request government ID
red.plain_english: Hinge can ask for your government ID for verification purposes, which is a serious privacy risk if provided.

green.title: User data rights available
green.plain_english: You can request to see, correct, or delete your data, though some information will still be retained.

green.title: Face data deleted within 30 days
green.plain_english: If you do not use the verification feature, your face geometry data is deleted within thirty days.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Hinge needs your camera for face verification and to upload profile photos.
categories.detail: Camera is used for profile photos and face geometry verification. Audio content may also be shared through chats.
categories.policy_excerpt: You may choose to participate in certain of our features, like Selfie Verification, that involve the collection of face geometry data

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Hinge collects your exact location if you give permission, to show you potential matches nearby.
categories.detail: Geolocation collected with permission for nearby matching. If you decline permission, features that rely on precise geolocation will not be available.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you give us permission, we collect your geolocation (latitude and longitude) from your device.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Hinge can import data from your social media accounts and collects information about others if you submit reports.
categories.detail: Social media imports and contact information of others are processed when you use certain features or submit reports involving other members.
categories.policy_excerpt: if you use the contact details of someone you know for a given feature or if you submit a query or report involving a member
concerns: Contact details of others processed through reports

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Hinge needs access to your photos and videos so you can upload them to your profile.
categories.detail: File access for uploading profile photos, videos, and audio content. You choose which content to share.
categories.policy_excerpt: you share photos, videos, audio, text and other types of content

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Hinge shares your data with companies that run the app, advertisers, and other dating apps in the same company. Your profile is visible to all members.
categories.detail: Shared with vendors (hosting, payments, analytics, security), advertising partners, and related companies for safety and cross-platform features. Your public profile is visible to other members.
categories.policy_excerpt: We share data with vendors and partners who help us operate, promote and improve our service. They provide us services such as data hosting and maintenance, analytics, customer care, marketing, advertising, payment processing, legal support, and security operations.

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Hinge collects extremely sensitive identity data including your sexual orientation, health, race, religion, and politics if you choose to provide it. It may also ask for government ID.
categories.detail: Sexual orientation, sexual life, health, racial or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, political affiliations, government ID, and face geometry are collected if you provide them. Some of this data is considered sensitive or special in certain countries.
categories.policy_excerpt: Some of this data may be considered sensitive or special in certain countries, such as details about sexual orientation, sexual life, health, racial or ethnic origins, religious beliefs or political affiliations.
concerns: Extremely sensitive data collected if provided

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Hinge tracks how you use the app and may share certain information with advertising partners to show you relevant ads. American users can opt out of some tracking.
categories.detail: Device and usage data tracked continuously. Shared with advertising partners. U.S. users may opt out of targeted advertising, sales, or sharing under applicable laws.
categories.policy_excerpt: To help improve the relevance of these ads, we provide certain info about you to third parties, including advertising partners
concerns: Interactions with ads on third-party sites tracked

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Hinge is an adult dating app and does not allow users under 18.
categories.detail: Dating app restricted to individuals 18 years of age or older. The platform does not permit individuals under 18.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our service is restricted to individuals who are 18 years of age or older. We do not permit individuals under the age of 18 on our platform.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Hinge logs your internet activity including which ads you interact with and where you downloaded the app from. This is used for safety and profiling.
categories.detail: Referring webpages, ads interacted with, and approximate download locations tracked. Customer care records and imprecise location of download retained for five years in support of safety efforts.
categories.policy_excerpt: information shown to you, referring webpages, ads you interacted with

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Hinge collects detailed device information to track you and keep your account secure.
categories.detail: Device and usage data collected continuously, including IP address, device ID, device type, operating system, app settings, advertising IDs, and identifiers associated with cookies or other technologies.
categories.policy_excerpt: IP address, device ID, device type, operating systems and configurations, network information, as well as app settings and characteristics, app crashes, advertising IDs

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Hinge collects your face geometry for verification and may collect health information if you include it in your profile. This is very sensitive data.
categories.detail: Face geometry collected for Selfie Verification. Health data may be provided in profile. Face data erased within thirty days normally, but biometric confirmation images may be retained for thirty-six months.
categories.policy_excerpt: You may choose to participate in certain of our features, like Selfie Verification, that involve the collection of face geometry data
concerns: Biometric confirmation images retained up to 36 months

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Hinge collects purchase records when you buy premium features. If you pay directly rather than through Apple or Google, you provide your card number.
categories.detail: Purchase records collected. If paying directly, debit or credit card number or other financial information is provided. Financial records retained for ten years to comply with tax and accounting legal requirements.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you pay directly with us (rather than through a platform such as iOS or Android), you provide your debit or credit card number or other financial information.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your Hinge account, but they keep your data for three months (or two years if you were banned). Financial records stay for ten years and customer service exchanges for five years.
categories.detail: Users may request access, correction, deletion, or restriction. Safety window: three months after closure, up to two years after ban. Financial records ten years. Face data thirty days. Customer care exchanges and approximate download locations retained for five years. Biometric confirmation images may be retained for thirty-six months.
categories.policy_excerpt: we keep customer care exchanges with you for five years from the date of the communication; customer care records and supporting data, as well as imprecise location of download/purchase, for five years
concerns: Biometric images kept up to 36 months

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Hinge says it will notify you before material privacy policy changes take effect so you have time to review them.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states that users will be notified before material changes take effect, allowing time to review changes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will notify you before material changes take effect so that you have time to review the changes.
